mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Harriet Park, and if you look up at 8:19 PM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling from Mount Horeb toward the East Northeast over Fitchburg and Madison, reaching almost directly overhead.
The City of Verona is preparing for the November 2026 General Election with various public notices now available at City Hall, alongside ongoing engineering reports coordinated through AECOM.

There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in town this Saturday.

The Verona Police Department has announced that applications are open for their Citizen Academy, while they continue their investigation into an incident reported on Sunday, August 30, 2026, regarding a school staff member.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Turtle Dove flavor of the day at Culver's, which remains open until 12 AM tonight.
